content:
Diagrams:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Alice
    participant Bob
    Alice->>Bob: Hello Bob
    Note right of Bob: Bob thinks
    Bob-->>Alice: Hi Alice
```

```mermaid
gantt
    title Release plan
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Build
    Write code :a1, 2025-01-01, 3d
    Review code :after a1, 2d
```

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Animal {
        +String name
        +eat()
    }
    Animal <|-- Duck
```

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Running : start
    Running --> [*]
```

```mermaid
erDiagram
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    CUSTOMER {
        string name
    }
```

```mermaid
pie title Pets
    "Dogs" : 40
    "Cats" : 60
```

```mermaid
journey
    title My day
    section Work
      Write code: 5: Me
      Review: 3: Me
```

```mermaid
mindmap
  root((Root))
    Branch one
    Branch two
```

```mermaid
timeline
    title History
    2020 : Started
    2021 : Shipped
```

```mermaid
C4Context
    title System context
    Person(user, "User", "A person")
    System(app, "App", "The system")
    Rel(user, app, "Uses")
```

```mermaid
usecase-beta
    actor Customer
    Customer --> PlaceOrder(Place order)
```
